name: Black Pepper (Piper nigrum)
description: Premium Malabar black pepper, hand-picked at peak ripeness. Known for its intense aroma and bold flavor.

name: Green Cardamom (Elettaria cardamomum)
description: Aromatic green cardamom pods from the Western Ghats. The "Queen of Spices" with distinctive sweet fragrance.

name: Clove (Syzygium aromaticum)
description: Premium quality cloves with intense aroma and warm, sweet flavor. Hand-picked and sun-dried to perfection.

name: Coriander Seeds (Coriandrum sativum)
description: High-quality coriander seeds with fresh, citrusy aroma. Essential for Indian cooking and spice blends.

name: Fennel Seeds (Foeniculum vulgare)
description: Sweet and aromatic fennel seeds, perfect for digestive blends and culinary applications.

name: Fenugreek Seeds (Trigonella foenum-graecum)
description: Premium fenugreek seeds with distinctive maple-like aroma. Rich in nutrients and flavor compounds.

name: Turmeric Powder (Curcuma longa)
description: High-curcumin organic turmeric powder, sun-dried and stone-ground. Valued for its health benefits and vibrant color.

name: Red Chili Powder (Capsicum species)
description: Vibrant red chili powder with perfect heat balance. Ground from premium quality dried chilies.

name: Ginger Powder (Zingiber officinale)
description: Premium dried ginger powder with warm, spicy flavor. Perfect for culinary and medicinal applications.

name: Kashmir Saffron (Crocus sativus)
description: World's finest saffron from Kashmir valleys. Hand-harvested premium quality threads with intense aroma and color.

name: Finger Millet (Ragi/Nachni)
description: Nutritious finger millet rich in calcium and iron. Traditional superfood grain perfect for health-conscious consumers.

name: Pearl Millet (Bajra)
description: High-protein pearl millet, drought-resistant grain with excellent nutritional profile. Gluten-free alternative.

name: Foxtail Millet (Kangni/Thinai)
description: Ancient grain with low glycemic index. Rich in protein, fiber and essential minerals. Perfect for modern diets.

name: Basmati Rice
description: Premium aged Basmati rice with distinctive aroma and long grains. The king of rice varieties.

name: Black Rice (Chakhao)
description: Antioxidant-rich black rice from Manipur. Known as forbidden rice, packed with anthocyanins and nutrients.

name: Red Rice
description: Iron-rich red rice with nutty flavor and chewy texture. Unpolished and nutritionally superior.

name: Cocopeat (Coir Pith)
description: Premium quality coconut husk byproduct. Excellent growing medium for gardening, hydroponics and potting mix.

name: Tamarind (Tamarindus indica)
description: Premium quality tamarind pulp, essential for South Indian cuisine. Rich in tartaric acid and natural preservatives.
